title: Revalidate CodeGraphContext candidate after upstream fix
description: Do not re-enable CodeGraphContext in the workspace MCP surface until a pinned upstream version returns real symbol data and passes the deep validation battery.
acceptance: A candidate CodeGraphContext version returns non-zero function or class stats after indexing a disposable repository
find_code and analyze_code_relationships return real symbol results for the disposable repository and the workspace before any future MCP registration
The workspace MCP registration, PLAN.md, and README.md are updated only after that validation battery is green
